# Armsys UI

> Framework-independent design system and UI library by Armsys Technology.

Armsys UI is a dark-first, scoped (`.aui`) HTML/CSS/vanilla-JavaScript design system for dashboards, admin tools, monitoring, corporate/product websites, documentation, pricing and public data pages.

## AI entry points

- [AI usage rules](AI_GUIDE.md)

- [Components](ai/components.json)
- [Patterns](ai/patterns.json)
- [Design tokens](ai/tokens.json)
- [Integration snippets](ai/integrations.json)
